lines: \section{Related Work}\label{sec:related}
\paragraph{Multi-turn dialogue and attention decay.}

-Multi-turn coherence has been a persistent challenge from early dialogue systems \citep{li2016persona,zhang2020dialogpt} through modern long-context models \citep{xu2022goldfish}, with benchmarks such as MT-Bench-101 \citep{bai2024mtbench101} continuing to expose quality gaps at later turns \citep{laban2025lost,liu2026intent}.
